title: Carlos Alcaraz exits Shanghai Masters in straight-sets loss

blocks.text: Carlos Alcaraz fell to Zizou Bergs in straight sets at the Shanghai Masters on Monday, interrupting the former world number one’s in-form return to the professional Tour after being sidelined for months by injury. The 39th-ranked Belgian beat the second-seeded Spanish star 7-5, 7-6 (7/4) in the third round to land the tournament’s biggest upset yet, and will play either Tommy Paul or Valentin Vacherot next. “It’s a little disbelief and not feeling too much,” Bergs, 27, said afterward.
